text:
From my understanding, the light emitted from my screen resembled a small image of a dog in a silly angle, there was a blue sky with a rainbow behind him as well (not misgendering, as we all know, modern science has indeed confirmed all dogs are in fact, good boys), this had me feel a vague sense of intrigue. The title of the video seemed to be confused as to how this would be my background music, so I figured, "Why not invite this playlist into my apartments' sound-space? I need to get the dishes done after all, and no matter how long I search, I just cannot find this mythical video that will both hold my interest and serve as bg noise at the same time." so here we are now, was it fate that drew me here? Was my deliberate choice to give this music a chance a real act of free will? Perhaps those questions don't matter, perhaps what really matters, is that I get those damn dirty dishes done. My apartment is nearly clean, and if one's living space reflects their head space, then mine would reflect that I'm healing, and stalling. The only way to do the dishes is to do them, so I have to decide to do them, I can't just get off now and say "Okay, I'll do some and come back." I think that's how they got completely piled up in the first place. It's time I stop waiting for motivation to hit, it's time to stop simply surviving, it's time to decide right here and now, "Do I want my home to reflect someone who is fully committed to healing and getting better, or do I want it to reflect someone who still can't break out of their old habits and cycles?" There's always help to get to that door, but I'm still the only one who can open it and walk thru it. Time to Scrub and Scour, Until it is Done . . .


* The battle has been won, but the war is far from over.
